name: Town Square
blurb: Where every cat arrives. The café and the shop are here.

name: Cat Homes Lane
blurb: A lane of little houses, one for each cat.

name: Lighthouse Point
blurb: A tall light over a sandy beach.

name: Sunny Cove
blurb: A boardwalk, a pond and a boat shed.

name: Scratching Peaks
blurb: Climb the scratching posts to the top.

name: Plaza
blurb: A paved strip of shop fronts: the pet shop, the pizza parlor and the way to the rink.

name: Whisker Woods
blurb: Wild friends live among the trees.

name: Dojo Courtyard
blurb: A training yard behind a waterfall. The dojo hall is through the door.

name: Ice Rink
blurb: Skates in winter, a soccer pitch the rest of the year.

name: Mine Shack
blurb: A little hut at the mouth of the old tunnels.

name: Harbour Dock
blurb: Boats bobbing at the end of a wooden pier.

name: Peakside Village
blurb: A few houses below the peaks, a path to the dock.

name: Fort
blurb: A stone yard between the plaza and the town, with the way to the rink.

name: Forest
blurb: Tall trees between the town, the cove and the mine.
